query: SELECT to_char(measured_at,'DD/MM HH24:MI:SS') AS "Date", ROUND(niveau_percent::numeric,1) AS "Niveau %", ROUND(distance_cm::numeric,1) AS "Distance cm", ROUND(hauteur_cm::numeric,1) AS "Hauteur cm", ROUND(volume_liters::numeric,0) AS "Volume L", ROUND(puissance_pompe_percent::numeric,0) AS "Puissance %", ROUND(debit_cm_s::numeric,1) AS "Débit cm/s", ROUND(servo_angle_deg::numeric,0) AS "Servo °", ROUND(vanne_ouverture_deg::numeric,0) AS "Vanne °" FROM sensor_measurements ORDER BY measured_at DESC LIMIT 15;
